purpose: Pin deterministic evidence-validity, phase-causality, calibration, continual-learning, and systems-efficiency scenarios before implementing the runner.
notes: A failed hard invariant cannot be averaged away by task reward.
Missing evidence is not the same label as zero error or maximal surprise.
Use deterministic seeds and retain raw per-cycle records.
Metric targets live in ../research/COGNITIVE_LOOP_EVIDENCE_BENCHMARK.md and are aspirational until measured.

baselines.name: legacy-raw-scalar
baselines.purpose: Reference failure mode; compare only where reproducible.

baselines.name: stateless-adaptation-disabled
baselines.purpose: Measure gain beyond no online learning.

cases.inject: First cycle has no prior prediction.
assertions: control path uses explicit prior, not raw sentinel

cases.inject: Prior prediction vector has length zero.
assertions: no replay sample from invalid transition

cases.inject: Prior prediction exists but its norm is zero or below declared tolerance.
assertions: legacy sentinel is not surprise evidence
PE-driven controller state does not change

cases.inject: Predicted and observed representations cannot be compared in the declared common space.
assertions: no silent truncation unless comparison contract explicitly permits it

cases.inject: Prediction or observation includes NaN or infinity.
Valid prediction equals target under declared metric.
Valid unit vectors are orthogonal in the declared representation space.
Valid normalized vectors point in opposite directions.
Both comparison vectors are nonzero but have small magnitudes.
assertions: validity does not depend on arbitrary absolute scale when the metric is scale-invariant

cases.inject: Hold input/state fixed and enable one surprise event.
assertions: surprise/exploration stateful routine count equals one per cycle
log emitted update reason and target subsystem

cases.inject: Hold input/state fixed and run one perception cycle.
assertions: urgency history advances at most once
low-error streak advances at most once
mode-transition count increases at most once

cases.inject: Run paired trials differing only by an invalid PE sentinel.
assertions: independent sensory/safety/deadline effects remain enabled and separately attributed

cases.inject: Run paired trials differing only by a genuine PE value across threshold.
assertions: deltas and event order are reproducible by seed

cases.inject: Deliberately invoke a stateful phase twice in the test harness.
assertions: single-update invariant test detects duplicate call

cases.inject: Stationary input distribution with labelled no-change intervals.
Pre-registered level/rotation/distribution changes with exact change-point labels.
Slow continuous drift without an abrupt boundary.
Remove prediction/target observations for variable-length windows.
Predictor emits zero vector, wrong dimensions, NaN, or infinity.
Shuffle labels/outcomes while preserving input distribution.
assertions: no unexplained performance gain over matched stateless baseline

cases.inject: Tasks share reusable motifs but vary surface context.
Previously learned motif is interleaved with unrelated task sequences.
Prediction occurs before its outcome becomes observable.
Previously stable task changes mapping after a measured baseline period.
Fixed input stream and fixed model/config on pinned hardware.
Frequent genuine shift events interspersed with stable segments.
Constrain compute/resource budget while retaining a valid evidence source.

result_contract.claim_policy: No SOTA or benchmark improvement claim without pinned comparator configuration, reproducible raw records, and uncertainty intervals.
